reason: Modify only model_design because the proposed experiment changes loss reduction inside dense_sampled_loss, without changing sampling, architecture, or inference. Current macro validation HR@10 is 0.5125 versus baseline 0.505, but Movies_and_TV declined from 0.580 to 0.515; this motivates testing recent-transition emphasis without establishing uniform weighting as the cause. Historical dense sampled-softmax successes support retaining that objective, while failed recency experiments warrant an isolated test with explicit per-prefix normalization and no assumed improvement.
